description.value: A free BC Hydro recreation site on a mountain reservoir above Chilliwack, offering basic camping with washrooms in a quiet backcountry setting; access is via a gravel forest service road that is rideable but rough for a loaded touring bike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM tags are the primary evidence source because the fetched BC Hydro website content contains only site-wide navigation menus with no Jones Lake-specific amenity text. OSM explicitly asserts shower=no, drinking=no, washing_machine=no, reservation=no, hot_water=no, and internet_access=no, which I treat as confirmed negatives. Hiker/biker-specific sites, food proximity, covered shelter, device charging, and other amenities are not referenced in either source, so they remain null.
concerns: Fetched BC Hydro website content contains only site-wide navigation; no Jones Lake-specific amenity details were captured, preventing website-based verification of any amenity.
No street address or phone number present in OSM record.
OSM tag drinking=no indicates no potable water on site — a significant concern for cyclists who must plan water carry accordingly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A free, no-reservation BC Hydro campsite accessible to cyclists without advance planning — a practical and legitimate overnight option for touring cyclists in the Chilliwack/Fraser Valley area.

wow_evidence: free BC Hydro recreation site… basic camping with washrooms… reservation=no
